title: Aathavan by Excello
excerpt: Eight storeys, 44 solar-powered residences at Carron Place.
body:
Aathavan is Excello's newest residential landmark at Carron Place, Dehiwala. The building rises eight storeys and holds 44 exclusive residences, with optimised two-bedroom homes from 1,020 square feet and three-bedroom homes from 1,380 square feet.

The entire complex runs on solar power, protecting homeowners from rising utility costs and keeping monthly maintenance low. Prices start from LKR 38 million, and Excello directly manages the property for the first two years after completion.

title: Sea Esta
excerpt: Sixteen sea-view villas beside the palm-fringed beach of Mount Lavinia.
body:
Sea Esta is a collection of sixteen villas set alongside the golden, palm-fringed beach of Mount Lavinia. Each villa is positioned to open toward the sea, and the layouts vary so that buyers can choose the plan that best fits how they live.

The result is a boutique community that balances privacy with a shared sense of place, moments from the water.

title: Rudra Wellness Retreat
excerpt: A retreat designed around calm, nature and restoration.
body:
Rudra is a wellness retreat shaped around stillness. The architecture frames the surrounding landscape, drawing daylight and greenery deep into the plan so that the building and its setting feel continuous.

Every decision, from circulation to material, was made to slow the pace and let guests rest.

title: Glen Aber Office Building
excerpt: A contemporary office building with a strong civic presence.
body: Glen Aber is a contemporary workplace that balances a confident street presence with efficient, light-filled floors. The facade is composed to give the building a clear identity while the interior prioritises flexible, well-lit space.

title: Private Residence
excerpt: A private family home in the heart of Colombo 07.
body: A private residence designed and built for a family in Colombo 07, resolving architecture, interiors and landscape as a single project so that nothing is lost between the drawings and the finished home.
